## Authorization (Guardrails `.claude/` exemption)

`.claude/` tooling change, maintainer-authorized. Verbatim instruction, given in-session by the maintainer (help@objectstack.ai) on **2026-08-10**:

> 「更新最新的项目经理技能」

Per the Guardrails exemption path this PR quotes the authorization above, is opened as **draft**, and ⛔ will **not** be self-review-self-merged by the authoring seat — it needs a walkthrough by the maintainer or another seat before it moves.

## What changed

Tail-appends four numbered entries to `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` → Operational notes (append-only; inserted after note 21, before the three-repo section). No existing text touched. Each note is a lesson the 2026-08-10 services-lane shift paid for first-hand and that the current skill text does not cover:

- **Note 22 — queue-kick signature: no own `merge_group` run = rebuild transient.** A PR kicked from the merge queue with **no `merge_group` run of its own** (siblings all `success`) was cancelled by a queue rebuild, not by a red (#7311, one flip re-queue → landed). Prescription: one receipted flip re-queue by the PM; a second kick on the same PR hands off to the queue steward (#5810). Also upgrades note 21's flip prescription from "3/3 cases" to confirmed-at-scale (every instance this shift, 6+, landed). Un-receipted re-queues are banned — they're indistinguishable from flaky hard-retries in the steward's ledger.
- **Note 23 — same-account claim-race arbitration (#7145).** All seats share one GitHub identity, so `assignee` carries zero information between two sessions; the claim comment's session ID + timestamp is the only tiebreaker (69-second race, first comment wins). The loser yields **with a handoff comment** carrying its already-done readings, not silently.
- **Note 24 — producer-forced out-of-surface rider is legitimate, not REWORK.** #7102 / PR #7224: ADR-0112 D3 mandates the error-code ledger row (`packages/spec`) land in the **same PR** as the minting. Three acceptance criteria (loud declaration / mandatory per ADR / no atomicity-preserving split), then ACCEPT + cross-seat declaration per the #6532 precedent. Distinguished from the existing #5586 note: that one covers the *landing point moving packages*, this one covers *an extra package appearing*.
- **Note 25 — Bash cwd resets every call in this environment: always `git -C <absolute-path>`.** Extends the existing cross-repo-grep rule to *all* git operations; a post-`cd` git call silently reads the wrong tree and returns a clean-looking absence — exactly the notes-6 failure shape.

## Review notes

- 37 insertions, 0 deletions, single file; diff is the four notes verbatim.
- No changeset: `.claude/` skill docs, not a published package (matches prior skill-update PRs).
- Requesting walkthrough: maintainer or another PM seat, per the exemption path. Points worth challenging: whether note 22's "second kick → steward" quota matches the steward charter in #5810, and whether note 24's three criteria are tight enough to not open a general out-of-surface door.
